changelog:
v3.6.1 — OTA download size cap raised

• Fixed: v3.6.0 OTA update couldn't download because the APK (199MB, up from ~80MB after Media3 1.9.0 + libVLC native libs) exceeded the 100MB in-app size cap. Cap raised to 400MB to cover future native-library growth.
• Users already on 3.6.0: no action needed. Users stuck on 3.5.x seeing 'can't download update': sideload v3.6.1 once, after which future OTA updates will self-heal.
